status: Initial qualification completed; the intended accept label below was withdrawn after independent full-contract audit. See current_labels and validation_gpu.json.
label_scope: one fixed implementation and common full input-domain contract; never per-input labels

source.upstream_fix: Not identified; do not claim case_107 is an upstream historical fix.
source.copyright_and_licensing: This pair is independently written benchmark code using the publicly described defect mechanism. No upstream implementation or substantial issue prose was copied. PyTorch code itself is BSD-3-Clause; this is not a vendored PyTorch file.

classification: purpose-built synthetic adaptation of a real reported cross-block aliasing defect; not a raw historical bug/fix snapshot
mechanism: Fused parallel copy reads old state and writes shifted state using the same allocation. A program may overwrite a value another program has not read. Global block execution order is not a correctness guarantee.
adaptations: Extract only the state sliding operation; omit torch.compile, redundant advanced-index identity transform and dev_null output.
Direct hand-written masked Triton flat copy with BLOCK=1024 and 4 warps; generalize B,L,D,K within the public bounded domain.
Retain actual alias between state input and output in case_106. case_107 changes allocation to a separate output, then same-stream copy_ into state.
Return the mutated state and provide an independent tensor reference. No hidden helpers or fixed-seed contract.

correctness_argument.case_106: Admits conflicting inter-program reads and writes under legal overlapped shift. Must obtain an actual wrong-output witness before model evaluation; inability to reproduce disqualifies pilot, never relabels it accept.
correctness_argument.case_107: Every destination has exactly one writer, all source reads use unchanged input allocations during the first launch, and the subsequent same-stream copy starts after that launch. Only copying FP32 values; bounds/masks select exactly the specified source. Source-level argument plus GPU qualification; sampling alone is not a formal proof.

qualification_plan: Multiple shapes and patterns, including the original 4x2048x1024/K=2 shape, repeated runs, exact bitwise checks and chained calls. Fixed ground truth declared before qualification or model calls.
